text: Brother, will you go to Powai? How much? Adjust a little, buddy!
Gully Indie weather watch! Monsoon arriving early this year. Carry the umbrella, expect waterlogged lanes by evening, and the sea breeze keeps it sticky. Stay dry out there, Bambai!
Hustle FM, the north update! New food hall opening near the highway, rents up another ten percent, and every third auto on the road is a delivery partner now. Grind on, Bambai!
